```{r}
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tibble)
library(AnnotationDbi)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)   
```

```{r}
short_barcode <- function(x) {
  
  sapply(strsplit(x, "-"), function(v) paste(v[seq_len(min(4, length(v)))], collapse="-"))
}

is_tcga_colnames <- function(nms) any(startsWith(nms, "TCGA-"))

read_counts_generic <- function(path) {
  mat <- fread(path) |> as.data.frame()
  
  if(!any(duplicated(mat[[1]]))) {
    rownames(mat) <- mat[[1]]
    mat[[1]] <- NULL
  }
  as.matrix(mat)
}


coad <- read_counts_generic("data/coad/count.csv")
if(!is_tcga_colnames(colnames(coad)) && is_tcga_colnames(rownames(coad))) {
  coad <- t(coad)
}

colnames(coad) <- short_barcode(colnames(coad))
coad <- as.matrix(coad)
storage.mode(coad) <- "integer"


read_mat <- read_counts_generic("data/read/count.csv")

colnames(read_mat) <- short_barcode(colnames(read_mat))


ens_ids <- sub("\\.\\d+$", "", rownames(read_mat))


map <- AnnotationDbi::select(org.Hs.eg.db,
                              keys = unique(ens_ids),
                              keytype = "ENSEMBL",
                              columns = "SYMBOL")


map <- map[!duplicated(map$ENSEMBL), ]


sym <- map$SYMBOL[match(ens_ids, map$ENSEMBL)]

keep <- !is.na(sym) & sym != ""
read_with_sym <- read_mat[keep, , drop = FALSE]
sym_keep <- sym[keep]



storage.mode(read_with_sym) <- "numeric"

read_sym_sum <- rowsum(read_with_sym, group = sym_keep, reorder = FALSE)
storage.mode(read_sym_sum) <- "integer"



pad_rows_to <- function(mat, all_genes) {
  out <- matrix(0L, nrow = length(all_genes), ncol = ncol(mat),
                dimnames = list(all_genes, colnames(mat)))
  common <- intersect(all_genes, rownames(mat))
  out[common, ] <- mat[common, , drop = FALSE]
  storage.mode(out) <- "integer"
  out
}


all_genes <- union(rownames(coad), rownames(read_sym_sum))

coad_full <- pad_rows_to(coad, all_genes)          
read_full <- pad_rows_to(read_sym_sum, all_genes)

counts_merged <- cbind(coad_full, read_full)
storage.mode(counts_merged) <- "integer"


nz <- rowSums(counts_merged) > 0
counts_merged <- counts_merged[nz, , drop = FALSE]


dir.create("data/prepared", showWarnings = FALSE)
write.csv(counts_merged, file = "data/prepared/counts_coad_read_HUGO_shortbarcodes.csv", quote = FALSE)
message("Saved: data/prepared/counts_coad_read_HUGO_shortbarcodes.csv  | ",
        nrow(counts_merged), " genes × ", ncol(counts_merged), " samples")
```

```{r}
as.data.frame(counts_merged)
```
